901.name: Old Whiskers
901.description: The legendary catfish of Floor 1's waters, whiskers as long as your arm. Some say it cooks.

3728.name: truffle
3728.description: A knobbly black truffle that smells of earth and rain. Cook it on a fire.

5678.name: turtle egg
5678.description: A leathery turtle egg from a Reedmarsh sandbar. Cook it on a fire.

3588.name: bramble berry
3588.description: A dark, sweet berry from the Bramble Run.

13992.name: Grilled Minnow
13992.description: Cooked from fish on a fire. Eat it and you heal a little faster out of a fight for 20 minutes.

14085.name: Smoked Perch
14085.description: Cooked from green perch on a fire. Eat it and your mana returns a little faster out of a fight for 20 minutes.

22187.name: Seared Meat
22187.description: Cooked from meat on a fire. Eat it and you heal a little faster out of a fight for 15 minutes.

12310.name: Boar Roast
12310.description: Cooked from ham on a fire. Eat it and you can carry a little more for 30 minutes.

3724.name: Roast Truffle
3724.description: Cooked from truffle on a fire. Eat it and a warm light goes with you for 30 minutes.

10453.name: Baked Turtle Egg
10453.description: Cooked from turtle egg on a fire. Eat it and you walk faster in town for 30 minutes.

10219.name: Carp Steak
10219.description: Cooked from salmon on a fire. Eat it and you heal a little faster out of a fight for 25 minutes.

16103.name: Whiskers Pie
16103.description: Cooked from Old Whiskers on a fire. Eat it and you heal a little faster out of a fight for 60 minutes.

31560.name: Honey-Glazed Ham

17820.name: Truffle Omelette
17820.description: A Baked Turtle Egg finished with truffle on the fire. Eat it and a warm light goes with you for 60 minutes.

6393.name: Bramble Tart

3602.name: Herb-Crusted Perch
3602.description: A Smoked Perch finished with sling herb on the fire. Eat it and your mana returns a little faster out of a fight for 40 minutes.

9218.name: Lieutenant's Badge
9218.description: A bandit lieutenant's tin badge. The wanted poster on the Bandit Road pays for it.
